title: A herdr pane's claude stops at the folder-trust dialog in a fresh worktree; the dispatch is lost and the run halts
description: Reported from a run in another repo (thorpeleverage, epic spq, 2026-10-11, herdr 0.9.3): the final-review tick was dispatched to a herdr pane running claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions … in a fresh worktree under ~/.herdr/worktrees/<repo>/…; Claude Code stopped at its folder-trust dialog ('Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?'), never reported interactive_ready within the 60s DefaultStartupTimeout (internal/exec/herdr/executor.go:162, not configurable), start_failed → supervision_halted attempt_unaddressed; on resume the pane read live (blocked) and held for a person. bypassPermissions does not skip the trust dialog. Fix: before launching claude in a pane, register trust for that worktree path the way Claude Code records it (~/.claude.json projects[<path>].hasTrustDialogAccepted) — only for worktrees ticfac itself created — or detect the dialog in the pane and answer/fail fast with a precise reason; make the startup budget configurable; a start_failed on a pane must re-dispatch (or fall back to the headless runner) rather than halt for a person.
acceptance_criteria: a review/close-out dispatched to a herdr pane in a never-seen worktree starts without a person; a pane blocked at a dialog is detected and reported precisely; the startup budget is configurable; test; make gate
